intent: Rewrite interface copy so it says what happens, in the user's words.
moves: Make button labels name the outcome — Save changes, not Submit; Delete project, not OK.
Rewrite errors to say what went wrong and what to do next, in that order.
Replace system vocabulary with the words a user would say out loud.
Cut leading pleasantries; the first word should carry meaning.
State what an empty state means and what to do about it.
avoid: Blaming the user in error copy, or blaming nobody with the passive voice.
Tooltips carrying information the user needs before they hover.
